pricing/token.json: where the run's copy of the pricing datasheet (pricing/datasheet.json, stored byte for byte) came from. The datasheet itself is not committed anywhere: its terms are not reviewed.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/token-pricing.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `e6069c17f6fe`.

## Top level

| Field        | Type                                                         | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `url`        | `string`                                                     | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `url_basis`  | `"runspec"`, `"price_book"`, `"bifrost_config"`, `"default"` | Yes      | Why this URL: the RunSpec's token\_pricing.url, the install's price book (token\_pricing.from\_price\_book), the Bifrost target's framework\_config.pricing\_url, or Bifrost's default. |
| `fetched_at` | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)      | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `sha256`     | `string`                                                     | Yes      | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`                                                                                                                                                                |
| `bytes`      | `integer`                                                    | Yes      | ≥ 1                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `entries`    | `integer`                                                    | Yes      | Model entries in the datasheet. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                     |
